rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides secure SSH connectivity to Linux systems with intelligent caching, connection pooling, and token optimization for efficient remote operations. Features comprehensive file transfer capabilities with MD5 and SHA256 verification, interactive shell sessions, batch command execution, and credential management through system keyring integration. Implements smart caching that distinguishes between static system information and dynamic data, connection reuse to minimize SSH overhead, and token-aware output filtering to optimize response sizes for large command outputs.
